en.text: Impressive work, Holliday.
Holliday is nothing, if not precise.
Your grandfather would be proud, Holliday.
Holliday, your grandfather casts a long shadow... but you can still make him proud. Summon The Archmother and she will help you find justice.
The eclipse is upon us, Holliday… don't squander this opportunity…
You didn't come this far just to fail now, Holliday. It's time to enact the ritual.
You hunt a monster, Holliday… destroy The Hidden King, and The Archmother will lend her aid.
You’re a long way from home, Holliday, but you're so close to finding the killer you seek. Complete the ritual and The Archmother will ensure your success.
Good work, Abrams…
Keep it up, Detective…
They cannot stop you, Abrams!
Detective Abrams…only The Archmother can relieve you of the tome. Summon her, and be free.
This is your chance to relieve yourself of the book's burden…complete the ritual, Abrams…The Archmother needs you.
Abrams, your strength will be a boon to your allies, and a bane to your rivals.
Only you were strong enough to bear the tome's weight, Detective Abrams… and soon you will be free of it.
Abrams, your team will count on your courage.
Baba is no simple grandmother.
Look at what an old witch can do...
No one can withstand Baba's magic.
You fear you will forget yourself, Baba. The Archmother will not let that happen.
Fifty years you have waited for this moment. You were always meant to complete this Ritual, Baba.
Fear not for your people, Baba. Once you summon the Archmother, no harm will come to them.
The Ritual will be finished by your hand. The Archmother will let no one usurp your rightful place.
Complete the Ritual, Baba... and let no one disrupt your rent controlled apartment.
Impressive, Bebop…
Bebop is setting the tone…
They weren't ready for someone like Bebop.
Miss Shelly's life is in your hands, Bebop… summon The Archmother, and she can be saved.
Your creator is counting on you, Bebop… don't fail her. Complete the ritual.
You are courageous in heart and deed, Bebop. You have the strength to complete the ritual.
It's time to fight for what you hold dear, Bebop… Summon The Archmother, and in doing so save Shelly Fisher's life.
The Archmother is counting on you, as is Miss Shelly. Summon her, Bebop.
Our blue guardian is under attack.
Our blue guardian has been destroyed.
Our blue guardian has been defeated.
Our blue walker is under attack.
Our blue walker has been destroyed.
Our blue walker has been defeated.
They destroyed the walker on Broadway.
I didn't think you had it in you, Paige.
I never expected Paige to be so lethal. It would seem this story has some surprises.
You've changed, Paige, your brother would be proud of you.
Your brother is in trouble, Paige. But while your words couldn't save him, today your actions can. Summon The Archmother.
You risk much by coming here, Paige, but you understand that this is the only way to save him. Complete the ritual and Mother will help you.
You've read so many stories, Paige… but today you write your own. Complete the ritual, and forge a new future for you and your family.
Paige, you are more than a protagonist. More than a hero. You my dear, are about to become a legend.
Today you find yourself in a crucible, but the love for your brother is stronger than iron. You will succeed. You will summon The Archmother. and you will heal your family.
Solomon outmaneuvers them.
Solomon will not be denied
What chance do they have against a grandmaster like Solomon?
You carry a heavy burden, Solomon. Complete the Ritual, and let the Archmother help you shoulder its weight.
Solomon. You stand in the way of tragedy. Let the Archmother be your sword and shield.
Solomon, you stand in the way of tragedy. Let the Archmother be your sword and shield.
The Archmother understands you, Solomon. Complete the Ritual, and allow her to temper the damage of the Maelstrom.
Your mind has been honed to a razor's edge, Solomon. Summon the Archmother, and never again fear the dulling of age.
Look at the monsters the Hidden King brings to the board. When you complete the Ritual, all their dreams will be dashed into nothing.
Exquisite work, Paradox.
I'm impressed, Paradox.
They never saw you coming, Paradox.
Paradox, your legend will only grow once you summon The archmother.
Paradox, you take what you want… don't let them stop you from completing the ritual.
Your organization has quite the reputation to uphold, Paradox… don't let them down.
You seek the validation of your colleagues, Paradox? Then steal the crown of The Hidden King and become legend.
Fight on behalf of The Archmother… and tear the Court of the Hidden King asunder.
Do whatever it takes to stop The Hidden King!
Don't let them complete the ritual!
The Hidden King comes for us!
Defend The Archmother!
Daniel is making short work of them.
Fairfax will not overlook what you've accomplished here, Daniel.
I was wise to invest in you Daniel
Daniel, your promotion is at hand. Summon the Archmother and take her Patronage.
He will see you, Daniel. He will see you truly, once you have completed the Ritual.
Beyond your service, beyond your loyalty - the Archmother sees the desire you suppress. Summon her, and let it be fulfilled.
No one will steal your glory again, Daniel, once you summon the Archmother...Fairfax and the entire world will know what you've accomplished.
Your voice will never be silenced. Your words will never be erased. Summon the Archmother, Daniel, and fear not oblivion for it will not touch you again.
The Doorman has begun his great work.
They underestimated The Doorman, and now they suffer for it.
This is who you are meant to be, Doorman.
The Archmother looks forward to your… reunion.
My my, well isn't this a pleasant surprise? The Archmother will be pleased to see you.
Thank you for stepping outside The Baroness to join us for the ritual.
You honor the Guided Hand by standing with us today.
You've shed your trappings to walk amongst humanity, but now you reclaim your rightful place.
The darkness creeps ever closer as The Drifter walks amongst them.
Dread inches over them as The Drifter's whistle dances on the wind.
Archmother: accept the gift that The Drifter has laid before us.
Enjoy yourself, Drifter… rend their flesh and complete the ritual.
Revel in the massacre, Drifter, it is my gift to you. All I ask in return is that you summon The Archmother.
They fear you, Drifter, as they should.
Welcome back to New York, Drifter, oh how we missed you.
Welcome back to New Amsterdam, Drifter. Oh, how we missed you.
Drifter. Today you sow terror in her name. Good hunting.
Excellent work, Professor…
Professor Dynamo, you are impressive as always…
Your conviction will be rewarded, Professor.
You've paid a terrible price for knowledge, Professor, but today you can make things right.
Marla is counting on you, Professor, don't let her down.
Your wife seeks to embrace flesh, not steel. Don't fail her. Don't fail yourself. Complete the ritual.
Professor, if it's knowledge you seek, The Archmother can provide it.
Professor, your allies will depend on you, as you will depend on them.
Rem, you are adorable.
You are small but mighty, Rem.
Let the blood of The Hidden King's disciples paint the path home.
You're lost, Rem, but The Archmother can guide you home. Summon her.
I know you're tired, Rem, but The Archmother needs you. Complete the ritual.
There's no need to be scared, Rem, once you complete the ritual, she will find your way home.
There's no need to be frightened, Rem, the Archmother is here to guide you to victory.
Your family misses you, Rem, and once you summon The Archmother you will see them again.
They will grow to fear Apollo's blade.
Yes… ventilate them all.
The prince of Ixia will stand triumphant.
Your father expects great things from you, and you will exceed them all. It's time to summon The Archmother.
The Archmother is blessed to count Ixian nobility amongst her allies.
The pride you have for your culture is inspiring. Complete the ritual so that all may see the might of Ixia.
Some may call you a child, but you have wisdom way beyond your years. Bring forth The Archmother, and she will help you achieve your dreams.
Hear me, Apollo, you are destined to surpass your father, and bring glory to all of Ixia. But before any of that can happen… you need to complete the ritual.
We only have one Shrine left!
Your brilliance is an example to us all McGinnis.
You're a clever one, aren't you, McGinnis?
It's a pleasure watching you work, McGinnis.
McGinnis… your services are needed.
Come, McGinnis, Complete the ritual.
Fairfax Industries is wasting your talents, McGinnis, you deserve better… and The Archmother can provide that for you.
Maggie. People judge you because they lack vision. But The Archmother understands. Summon her.
McGinnis, your inquisitive mind and ingenuity is needed to complete the ritual.
Victor shares his pain.
Death has no hold on you, Victor, kill them all.
No one can stand against Victor.
You have many questions, Victor, but only The Archmother can provide answers.
Your mind resides in the body of strangers. But that need not be so. Complete the ritual.
What do you see when you look in the mirror, Victor? Yourself? Or a stranger? Where do you end and he begins? Summon The ARchmother and find closure.
You're in pain, Victor, more than you ever let on, more than any could ever know. But it need not be the case. Complete the ritual, and let our Mother be a balm to soothe you.
You were made for a purpose, Victor, and The Archmother can show it to you once you complete the ritual.
They're attacking our Shrines!!
Revel in your nature, Geist.
Oathkeeper is rubbing off on you, isn't he…
Yes… satiate the Oathkeeper… kill them all.
Oathkeeper hungers, Geist, but The Archmother can help you satiate him.
Lady Geist, your condition demands a permanent solution…. Summon the Archmother, and let her help you.
The strength of Oathkeeper is nothing before the power of The Archmother… complete the ritual, and earn her favor.
Your beauty need not fade, Geist… it's time to complete the ritual.
It's wise of you to turn to the mother for aid, Geist. You do your part, and she will honor her covenant.
Exquisite work, Seven…
They cannot hide from you, Seven.
Seven is their nightmare made flesh.
Your freedom. Your life. All was taken from you, Seven, but it can be restored.
You were punished for seeking knowledge, but history is not written in stone, Seven.
You wear your desire on your sleeve, Seven, and The Archmother can provide it for you.
Complete the ritual, Seven, and earn what was denied you.
First your destiny was denied to you. Then your lover tried to steal it for themselves. But now with The Archmother's help, it can finally be yours.
Our green guardian is under attack.
Our green guardian has been destroyed.
Our green guardian has been defeated.
Our green walker is under attack.
Our green walker has been destroyed.
Our green walker has been defeated.
They destroyed the walker on Greenwich.
Impressive as always, Haze.
You are perfection, Haze.
Haze will tear through them all.
Come dream walker, make history…
Haze, I know what you seek. Summon the Archmother, and she shall provide it.
You've walked through countless dreams, Haze, it's time to live your own.
You sacrificed so much in the name of duty. But today, you will be made whole.
You're more than a killer, Haze. You're not some tool to be discarded. Complete the ritual, and let The Archmother help you.
Your service to your country is admirable, Haze… but it's time to fight for what YOU want…
They will curse your name, Vindicta.
Vindicta is imposing her will on them.
Your skills are impressive, Vindicta…
You were wronged, Vindicta, but together we will make things right.
Hathorne's bloodline will pay for his sins. All you need to do is summon The Archmother.
You deserve your revenge, Vindicta... And today you will have it.
Complete the ritual, and the Friends of Humanity will fall before you.
18 souls joined you in Salem. Today you will have your satisfaction.
Keep fighting, Infernus…
Burn them all, Infernus!
Infernus is turning the Court of the Hidden King into a funeral pyre.
You are more than your past, Infernus… you can't undo what's been done, but this is your chance to build rather than destroy. Summon her.
Hank is counting on you to complete the ritual, Infernus…
Infernus, with your help, your allies will know glory.
Summon The Archmother, Infernus, and she will give you what you seek.
You built a life for yourself here in New York, Infernus... but it could be so much more.
Kelvin endures, as must you all.
Kelvin is vexing them…
Your rivals curse Kelvin's name…
The grave could not hold you, Kelvin, and that resolve is needed once more.
You dedicated your life to the pursuit of knowledge and adventure, and it's all lead to this moment…
It's time, Kelvin. Finish what you started all those years ago. Complete the ritual.
Don't let the members of your expedition die in vain. Summon The Archmother.
Glory has followed you throughout your life, Kelvin, and it will continue today.
Oh how they fear Maurice and Krill.
Impressive team work, Krill.
Maurice and Krill are tearing them apart…
Maurice. Krill. Summon The Archmother , and you two will have your heart's desire.
Usher in The Archmother, and she will owe you both a powerful debt.
You two have endured much to come this far… and you will not fail. Complete the ritual, and earn your reward.
Power. Respect. Glory. All this and more await you both if you complete the ritual.
The world counted you both out, but not only did you endure… you thrived. So it will be today; and when you summon the Archmother you will be rewarded in kind.
Lash is living up to his reputation.
Lash is inflicting such delightful misery.
Oh lash…. What can't you do…
Your bravado is born in reality, not arrogance. And soon the world will understand all that you are. Summon The Archmother, Lash.
The world hates you, Lash, for when they gaze upon you they realize all that they can never achieve. But soon, your critics will be silenced.
The ritual awaits, Lash. And once you complete it your greatness will no longer be in doubt.
Lash… soon your rivals' tears will flood the streets, and wash away the sins of the past.
I know what your heart yearns for, Lash. And you're so close to having it. Summon The Archmother, and let your dreams become real.
Yes, Sinclair, show them your greatness.
Such clever prestidigitation, Sinclair.
You're putting on quite the show, Sinclair.
Sinclair, your fate and souls are intertwined, but the Archmother can separate them.
Henry. Savannah. You wish to be free of each other. Then summon The Archmother, and have your dreams become reality.
Complete the ritual, Sinclair, and have the folly of your youth undone.
Henry. Savannah. You must put aside your petty squabbles, only then, may you be free of each other.
Two souls wrestling for control of one body is not sustainable, but The Archmother can set things right. Summon her.
Your service is appreciated, Mirage.
The Djinn were wise to put their trust in Mirage.
Mirage, we are as blessed by your presence as our rivals are cursed because of it.
You seek to change the world, Mirage, doing that will come at a price.
Complete the ritual Mirage… make Nashala's dreams your reality.
Mirage; you're a man of service. Of action. Complete the ritual; and earn your just reward.
The Djinn deserve to have a place to call their own; but birthing a nation is not easy. Summon The ARchmother, and let her help you.
Nashala is in peril, Mirage, and even you cannot save her. But The Archmother can. Complete the ritual and summon her, and she will give you the aid you need.
You're delightful, Calico…
Calico is sowing chaos.
Good work, Calico.
You're a dangerous woman, Calico… but you are not the Apex Predator. Summon The Archmother and she can protect you.
Your past will catch up with you eventually, Calico, but if you complete the ritual, Mother can prevent that from happening….
You don't just have ambition… you have the means to execute on it. Summon the archmother, and reap your reward
They paint you as Judas for turning your back on The Baxter Society, but The Archmother will never judge you. Complete the ritual, and find peace.
The bond between you and Ava will only be strengthened once you complete the ritual.
Excellent, Graves.
The young necromancer is earning her keep.
Graves will usher us into The Archmother's new era.
Your devotion to your mentor is admirable, Graves… use what she taught you to complete the ritual.
Darcy Graves. You have been misunderstood your whole life, but The Archmother sees you. Complete the ritual, and others will as well.
You work tirelessly to honor the dead and bring them peace. The Archmother is counting on that same devotion.
Graves. Your will lets you dabble in things men twice your age would cower at. Use this resolve to summon The Archmother.
Many souls are in your debt, Graves. If you finish the ritual, The Archmother herself will join that number.
Our orange walker has been destroyed.
With every arrow Grey Talon brings us closer to victory.
Talon is ventilating our rivals.
And this, Grey Talon, is why you are legend.
Grey Talon, your past has caught up with you. Complete the ritual, and The archmother can make things right.
Peace is never given to men like you, Talon... it is only borrowed. But if you summon The archmother, she can make you whole.
Talon, summon The Archmother and you will have your revenge.
Hathorne's disciples will answer for their crimes. Together, we will make them suffer in ways unimaginable.
The law can never provide justice… but The Mother can. Complete the ritual, Talon, and know peace.
The Venator fights with fervor.
The Sword of Saint Benedict cuts them down like wheat.
Oh how the disciples of the Hidden King cower before Father Quinn.
The Hidden King is a threat to everyone, Venator, good luck on your hunt.
Father Quinn...I know you question if this is the right course of action, but it is. The Hidden King threatens us all.
Thank you for realizing that the Archmother is not your enemy today. May your hunt be successful, Father.
Venator, your faith is like iron, your fury righteous, and both will be needed to stop the Hidden King.
You have slain the things of people's nightmares, but you have never faced someone like the Hidden King. Together with the Archmother, you have a way to end his reign.
Let your rage spill forth, Billy
Yes, Billy, let your fury drive you.
Billy continues to cave in their skulls.
Billy. They fear you. They mock you. They hate you. Make them pay for their transgressions and summon The ARchmother.
You're filled with passion, Billy, it's time to direct it with purpose and complete the ritual.
The world is corrupt and beyond saving. But if you summon the archmother, she can help you change that.
Injustice permeates this city like a weed. You know this. Complete the ritual, and together with The Archmother, build a new world.
They underestimate you, Billy. Let their hubris fuel their demise and your triumph.
The rat king has begun his conquest.
See how they cower before the king of the rats
The rat king has been crowned in blood.
Louis, your people live in squalor and fear. Complete the Ritual, and the Archmother will share her bounty with them.
Stop the minions of the Hidden King and the Archmother will adorn your head with his emptied crown.
Humanity has killed and reviled ratkind for ages. Summon the Archmother, and give your people a homeland no one can take from them.
Your people call out for succor, Louis. Summon the Archmother and deliver them from their pain.
The Archmother wants Long Island to be yours. Do not keep her waiting. Complete the Ritual and see it done.
Time is running out on the Rejuvenator.
You won't have the Rejuvenator for much longer.
There's still time to push with the Rejuvenator.
May your blades continue to strike true, Shiv.
Dance amongst them, Shiv, and sow chaos.
Tear them to pieces, Shiv.
Shiv, you are a marriage of style and substance. Summon the archmother, and earn your reward.
Complete the ritual, Shiv, and your kingdom will be built atop the bodies of our enemies.
The Baxter Society is counting on you, Shiv, don't fail your brothers…
You found a new family in the Baxter Society, and now you fear them turning on you… but if you complete the ritual The Archmother can ensure that never happens.
A life spent looking over your shoulder is no life at all… Summon The Archmother, Shiv, and know that your future is secure.
Good work, Pocket!
Pocket is giving us an opportunity for greatness.
It's a joy watching Pocket work.
You wish to be free of your parent's shadow, Pocket? This is your chance.
Your ambition reaches across the planes, Pocket…
Real power is at your fingertips, Pocket.
This is your opportunity to have your name carved into legend.
You are so much more than people label you, Pocket. Today you prove that.
You wish to stop your Father, Pocket… the world is full of craven yes men who wouldn't dare to help you. But The Archmother can and will. Summon her.
Ivy, your presence is a boon to us all.
Thank you for standing with The Archmother, Ivy. We need your help.
Ivy will deliver us from The Hidden King's tyranny.
You're lost, Ivy. Directionless. But I see beyond what your heart wants… I see what you need. Summon The Archmother so that she may provide it.
Once you were the savior of Spanish Harlem… and now you will be a savior to your allies.
I know how much you care for the Arroyos. And their future can be secured… all you need to do, is complete the ritual.
Summon The Archmother, Ivy… and know that the Arroyos' kindness to you will be repaid tenfold.

Ivy, your flesh is stone, but your heart is ablaze. For some, such kindness would be their downfall; but for you it is the source of your strength…and that strength will be needed to complete the ritual.
We need to make a stand and stop them!
Our defenses are crumbling!
Celeste, you are full of surprises, aren't you?
Yes, Celeste…. Inspire us to greatness.
Celeste, you are the marvel of Coney Island.
Do not be timid, Celeste, The Archmother believes in you.
You've made a pleasant life for yourself, Celeste, yet you don't feel safe. Complete the ritual and The Archmother will lend you her warmth and her strength.
Your found family lives in the margins of society. You lie to yourself and say you like it that way. We both know the truth, Summon The Archmother and usher in a new world, with you by her side.
Even in a world of magic people question your very existence. It's wrong. But The Archmother can set things right.
Celeste, your found family counts on you. Don't let them down. Complete the ritual.
The Urn is ours!
The urn is ours!
We must deliver the Urn safely.
Protect the Urn runner.
Mina Ha. Rise up and take what you deserve.
Mina darts amongst them, a perpetual thorn in their side.
Oh how Mina's crimson children make them scream.
You had the world at your fingertips and it was stolen from you by an assassin's bullet. But it's not too late to change your future. Summon The Archmother.
The Vampire Nation will never make someone like you Viscount of New York. But if you summon the archmother, she can get you the title you seek.
The other vampires are old. Weak. Not in power, but in spirit. In vision. But not you. You have the chance to lead the Barony of New York to new heights… but first you must complete the ritual.
You may not be a Fairfax, but you are something greater. You are Mina Ha… the woman who heralds The Archmother's arrival to this plane.
Once you complete the ritual, Arin will realize their folly. And the other vampires, your worth.
Yes, Vyper…slaughter them all.
Oh Vyper… you are so beautiful.
They have no answers for you, Vyper. Go child, and eradicate them.
You slink from shadow to shadow, Vyper, longing for security that always eludes you. But if you complete the ritual, you will find what you seek.
I see into your heart, Vyper. I know what you want. And you can have it… all you need to do is summon The Archmother.
Your whole life you've been painted as a failure. But you and I both know you've always been destined for so much more. It's time to realize your dreams. It's time to complete the ritual.
The life you've longed for is not a fantasy…it could be yours. But first you need to summon The Archmother.
Vyper, the cycle can be broken. A new life awaits you once you've completed the ritual.
Viscous brings safety to our allies, and endless frustration to our enemies…
You're unkillable, Viscous…
Viscous… you are guile personified…
The Deep is depending on you, Viscous, and you won't let them down.
You're new to this city, and already you understand the machinations of man… summon the archmother, and your dreams will become her cause.
Everyone looks at you and discounts your value. But not me. And not The Archmother. Complete the ritual, and let her help you.
Viscous, the needs of The Deep weigh on you. But soon you will complete the ritual, and that burden will be relieved.
The Adversary comes for your people, Viscous… but together we can save The Deep.
Such heroism, Warden..
Impressive as always, Warden.
Warden is destroying them!
Warden, your conviction is needed to complete the ritual.
I know you don't trust easily, Warden. But your faith in The Archmother is not misplaced. Together you can kill The Hidden King.
You've waited your whole life for this moment, Warden: seize it.
Your will is stronger than they could ever know, Warden.
I know you hate The Archmother Warden, but today she is not your enemy… she is the path that will lead you to destroying The Hidden King once and for all.
The wolf preys on our enemies.
They can't hide from Silver.
Silver is relentless, and The Archmother is grateful.
Your life's a mess, Silver. But it doesn't have to be that way. Let The Archmother's guidance lead you to a better life.
Silver, you've never been a slave to the moon, and you refused to be The Hidden King's thrall. Destroy him. Complete the ritual. And live free.
The Hidden King would turn you into a war doll for his purposes, but this is not the Mother's way. If you choose to fight for her, she will set you free.
Lilah Silver. Yours is a…complicated life. But if you complete the ritual, The Archmother will make sure you thrive.
Your life is hollow, Silver, but The Archmother can help you find meaning.
Good work, Wraith.
They don't have any answers for Wraith.
One by one they'll fall before you, Wraith.
Your business is thriving, Wraith, and still you yearn for more… Summon The Archmother, and she will help you find what you seek.
Wraith. Summon The Archmother so that she may guide you to a new era of prosperity and strength.
Despite your exterior you know in your heart that the walls are closing in… that all you built is threatened…complete the ritual and The ARchmother will ensure your legacy is secure.
You live your life one step ahead of death… let The Archmother provide the security you seek.
Your fortune is waiting for you, Wraith. Complete the ritual.
Yamato's blade strikes true.
Yamato has an elegant brutality about her.
Yamato leads by example.
Yamato, you honor your brother by taking his name… but there is more work to be done to enshrine his legacy.
The 7th Moon needs you to lead them to a new era. Complete the ritual. Summon The Archmother. And know their future is secured.
You have overcome grief and betrayal to stand here today… but you seek to do more than just survive. Complete the ritual.
Under your leadership, the 7th Moon could run New York… all you need to do is complete the ritual.
The 7th Moon is counting on you, Yamato… don't let them down.
Our yellow guardian is under attack.
Our yellow guardian has been destroyed.
Our yellow guardian has been defeated.
Our yellow walker is under attack.
Our yellow walker has been destroyed.
Our yellow walker has been defeated.
They destroyed the walker on York.
Enemies have breached our stronghold…
You fought off the Court of the Hidden King, but they will return.
The sheriff is protecting her own!
Abrams is keeping us in the fight!
Baba grants her blessings to us.
I can see why you're Miss Shelly's caretaker, Bebop…
Thank you for shielding us, Paige.
Paige is our protector, and she has our gratitude.
You are likened to a modern day Galahad, Paige.
You are always so protective, Solomon.
Today Paradox doesn't steal…she gives life!
Yes, Daniel. Show us that Fairfax Industries can do more than destroy
Doorman, thank you for sharing the hospitality of The Baroness.
I thought I knew you, Drifter, what a pleasant surprise to see you healing others.
Professor, your work is as impressive as it is necessary…
You care for your team as you do your students, Professor.
You are a caregiver, Professor… and The Archmother thanks you.
Rem is doing what he can to keep us standing.
Sweet Rem. Thank you for your aid.
Rem. Without your help, we would be in peril.
The golden child of Ixia mends our wounds.
Keep up the good work, McGinnis, your team needs you!
Fairfax industries has invested in our survival.
We are grateful for your aid, McGinnis.
Victor, despite your pain you care for others. We are in your debt.
Geist… how unlike you to care for others…
I didn't realize you were capable of mercy, Seven…
I didn't realize you were capable of mercy, Seven.
And so the Sandman has decided to look after life rather than take it…
Thank you for your service, Vindicta…
Infernus is helping us endure….
I knew the Guided Hand could count on you, Kelvin…
Thank you for tending to our wounds, Kelvin.
With Kelvin's help, death will not find us.
Maurice, thank you for helping the Guided Hand…
I didn’t expect you to look after your team so well, Lash…
The Sinclairs tend to their allies.
Mirage is protecting us the best he can…
The Hidden King would never expect Calico to heal so effectively…
Graves cares for the living as she does the dead.
Talon, thank you for protecting The Archmother.
You're quite the Samaritan, Father.
Billy is helping us stay in the fight. Pay tribute to the goat.
The King of the Rats offers us protection
Shiv endures, so we all may survive…
Pocket is keeping us standing!
Ivy is doing whatever she can to help us survive!
Celeste's kindness has not gone unnoticed.
Mina offers barbs to our enemies, and salvation to our allies.
